[Sign out and keep them running] [Cancel all algos…]), and SCR-074's block says "Cancel these 3 algos or let them finish before switching", a paused algo still having orders at Bybit and blocking the switch (DJ); a browser close cannot be intercepted reliably, so the count, not a dialog, is the control

kids.name: title
kids.chars: 9b. Config defaults for E33-T01 (#993) and E33-S01–S04 (E33-T03 writes them into 24 and 22)

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: keep oms.algo.max_children=450, max_failures=3, resume_deadline_ms=5000, reconcile_interval_s=30, default_on_disconnect=freeze (no builder override in R3); AlgoRun and algo_run carry its working orders at Bybit (24 AlgoState.active_child_ids) and gain, PROPOSED (absent from 24 and 22 today), chart_state, paused_by, park, market-conversion and cancel causes, a resumes-by-itself flag, last_reconciled_at (re-sent at each reconcile), resumed_at and, for a TWAP, shortfall_qty and end_at_us (S5); a disconnect pause resumes after reconciliation (PROPOSED) unless the account went down or a bound no longer holds

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: builder interval 60 s, slices derived, at most min(450, duration ÷ 1 s); randomize_time_pct=0.25, randomize_qty_pct=0.20; catch_up="proportional"; max_participation_pct=None; order_type="limit", limit_offset_ticks=0; abort_on_price_limit=False; window end as a TwapParams field (PROPOSED): a market sweep within price_limit or max_participation_pct (else the rest stays unfilled), and leave as limit when neither is set, the default (SR-E33-03); oms.algo.twap.min_slice_interval_ms=1000; oms.algo.twap.max_spread_ticks unset; a resume keeps the end time (default) or extends it through end_at (PROPOSED) within 24 h of the start, paused time included (SC-3; SR-E33-04)

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: randomize_pct=0.2 (22's randomize_display_pct default becomes 20), refill_delay_ms=250, refill_jitter_ms=250, price_mode="fixed", post_only=True, max_slices=450, so display_qty ≥ total ÷ 360; an outside cancel pauses the run (F18; PROPOSED, a B5 change)

kids.name: c2
kids.chars: reprice_interval_ms=500 over the oms.algo.chase.min_reprice_interval_ms=200 floor; max_repricings = timeout_ms ÷ reprice_interval_ms (120) under oms.algo.chase.max_repricings_cap=500; timeout_ms=60000; on_timeout="cancel"; a new at-max-distance policy (PROPOSED; cancel or leave, default cancel); mode="maker", offset_ticks=0, reprice_threshold_ticks=1, post_only=True (off for taker); max_chase_ticks required

kids.name: c2

kids.name: intro
kids.chars: The E33 threat model (E33-X01, Draft) names "emulated algos stop when the backend stops" as residual AS-D05 (§4.2, §11.2), beside AS-S02 (a stolen session starting a demo run): the Owner's acceptances are queued on #2701, and only the model's approval PR records them, not this memo. Its mitigation set is SR-E33-20, whose visibility item (§4.2 item 3) rests on this research (open input O-1); these UI controls spell that item out, each testable in E33-S05/S06 and E33-D07:

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the §3 caveat in every builder state and the tag's accessible name (F6–F9)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the §4 three-case copy and reconnect report (F10, F11)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: orders at Bybit per run and in total (F17)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the pause cause and whether it resumes by itself (F15)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: a halt with its cause, who and when (SC-8; SR-E33-19), restart only as a new confirmed run (F16)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: the running-algo count, restated at sign-out and on SCR-074's block (F6)

kids.name: line-1
kids.chars: a close or flatten names the algos it cancels (F29)
